prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1210; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm whether a claim has been opened and provide the claim number assigned.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and any surveillance or investigative materials. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
